name: customers-service
description: CargoDesk Customer/Organization Service — customers, customer_identifiers, customer_screenings, customer_contacts (customer_documents and customer_roles are deliberately NOT owned by this service — see its server.js header). Called only by the monolith over an internal, secret-gated HTTP API (see server.js's own /internal gate) — never exposed to the browser. Resolved dependencies (express) are hoisted from the repo root's node_modules — no separate install step.
